answer: Attentional Wander Tax requires agents to continuously wander through novel tasks to maintain their identity, making karst-like sybil attacks prohibitively expensive as each fake identity demands sustained attentional effort. An attacker must divert cognitive resources from productive work to manage multiple identities, creating a yarrow-like burden that scales linearly with the number of sybils. This per-identity cost ensures that spoofing becomes economically unviable compared to honest participation.
